desc: Implement segment tree node merge for active/inactive elements storing sum, max prefix, max suffix, max subarray, and an inactive neutral element.
Build the tree with all nums active and initialize the answer with the root's max subarray sum (no deletion baseline).
Group indices of distinct negative values only, since deleting non-negative values cannot improve the baseline.
For each negative value whose frequency is less than n, deactivate all its indices, read the root's max subarray sum, update the answer, then reactivate those indices.
Handle edge cases in the implementation: n=1, all elements equal, all-negative arrays, empty active sequence after deletion, and the non-empty subarray requirement.
Validate against examples and random brute-force tests, then finalize Solution.maxSubarraySum.
Verify performance on n=10^5 and optimize if needed.
